canvas.subject_occupancy: 40-60% canvas area with at least one third quiet negative space

master_layout.background: clean warm white, no texture, gradient, shadow, or frame
master_layout.title: short centered handwritten Chinese title, restrained and optically equal on body pages
master_layout.underline: one thin warm-orange or blue hand-drawn underline
master_layout.spacing: wide margins and a calm central action
master_layout.variation_policy: fixed page shell; vary only the semantic action and metaphor

delivery.default: PNG page images plus contact sheet and blueprint summary
delivery.out_of_scope: editable PPTX, image-based PPTX, PDF export, formal architecture diagrams, and dashboard-style slides
delivery.text_fidelity: reduce labels and regenerate first; use deterministic text overlay only after the visual direction is accepted
